title: Directory
description: A dated, retrievable package of a publisher's whole organizational structure, expressed as a schema.org DataFeed. Without this an org chart is only a pile of files with no statement of what the set contains, when it was current, or who stands behind it. A consumer polls one URL and can tell whether anything changed.

publisher.description: The GovernmentOrganization asserting this directory. Required: an unattributed directory cannot be trusted or corrected.

dateModified.description: When the directory last changed. Required, and the field a polling consumer reads first.

conformanceLevel.description: gov-schema conformance level claimed, per SPEC section 4. Distinct from conformsTo, which names an external standard the data follows.

dataFeedElement.description: References to every entity in the directory. References, never inlined copies - see SPEC section 1.2.
